title: What If We Built a Dyson Sphere Around the Sun?

scenes.text: What if we built a Dyson sphere around the Sun? First, we'd have to take apart a planet.
The Sun puts out roughly four hundred trillion trillion watts, and nearly all of it escapes into empty space.
A Dyson sphere would capture it with a swarm of orbiting solar collectors, not one solid shell.
One researcher's plan builds them from Mercury. About half of the planet is usable material.
Mining it in ten-year surges, Mercury could be gone in roughly forty years.
Then the Sun's output could power us, even beamed to Earth. We'd have to build the whole swarm piece by piece.
